title: Uninsured Discount Policy — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
This policy governs the uninsured discount on the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing). Three of its original sentences are **no longer in force**; the remaining sentences stand as written.

## Sentences no longer in force

1. The sentence that the uninsured discount applies only when the account's financial class is self-pay at final bill is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. The condition of the same wording, read from the account's financial class as the system records it, is no longer in force either.
2. The sentence that the discount is posted once per self-pay final-bill liability, as an uninsured discount adjustment whose source is that liability posting, at the uninsured discount percent of the liability for emergency and medically necessary services and at the elective uninsured discount percent for elective non-covered services, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
3. The sentence that, on an insured account, a non-covered-service liability line receives the same uninsured discount percent only on patient classes where the schedule grants the discount on an insured patient's non-covered services, and that deductible, coinsurance and copay amounts never receive it, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

The retirement concerns these handling sentences only. The figures of the uninsured discount schedule (the uninsured discount percent, the elective uninsured discount percent, the yes-or-no for an insured patient's non-covered services, and the rounding basis of each patient class) remain valid.

## Sentences in force

- Discount amounts are rounded half-up to the cent.
- An account priced under a Riverbend self-pay package receives the package price adjustment instead and never the uninsured discount.
- A later financial-assistance charity adjustment is computed by the assistance program on its own basis and does not reverse the uninsured discount.

## Points of reading

- *Package-priced account.* An account carrying a Riverbend self-pay package price adjustment receives no uninsured discount of any kind.
- *Charity after discount (hypothetical).* An account whose uninsured discount was posted and that later receives a charity adjustment keeps the uninsured discount; the charity adjustment is figured by the assistance program on its own basis.
- *Rounding (hypothetical).* A computed discount of 88.126 is posted as 88.13.

superseded_clauses: On an insured account, a NONCOVERED_SERVICE liability line receives the same uninsured_discount_pct only on tiers where uninsured_discount_on_noncovered_insured is true; deductible, coinsurance and copay amounts never receive it.
The uninsured discount applies only when the account's financial_class is SELF_PAY at final bill.

It is posted once per SELF_PAY_FINAL_BILL liability, as an UNINSURED_DISCOUNT adjustment whose source is that liability posting, at uninsured_discount_pct of the liability for EMERGENCY and MEDICALLY_NECESSARY services and at uninsured_discount_elective_pct for ELECTIVE_NON_COVERED services.
